Written in parallel; whichever lands second merges `main` and re-runs the other's delete pins. Open PRs #23628 (#23586), #23626 (#23577) and #23504 (#23473) are in other regions.

File surface amended 2026-10-15T11:1xZ by this seat (same session), on the dev's report 6190601887 (`deviations[0]`): the measured producer is the code-layer read the heal's tier 2 calls, so the fix lands in `readItemFromMetadataService` (an `object` body stamped tenant-authored is a clean miss) and in `readFlattenedMetaItems`' list merge (the same predicate), both in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`; `restoreArtifactRegistryView` itself gains a header note only. The new pin file is `packages/objectql/src/protocol-delete-boot-hydrated-object-heal.test.ts` (`domain:engine`).
